summary: Plum Acquisition Corp. III, a SPAC, furnished pro forma financials via Form 8-K regarding its pending business combination with Tactical Resources Corp. and Plum III Merger Corp. The filing supplements the previously announced Asset Purchase Agreement among PubCo, Sierra Blanca Quarry, LLC, and Tactical. No new deal terms (price, premium, stake) or board recommendation are disclosed; the pro formas are unaudited and for illustrative purposes only. The filing is a procedural update, not a definitive agreement announcement. What to watch: regulatory closing conditions and shareholder vote timing for the de-SPAC transaction.
